title: Voting Precincts
description: Voting Precincts in Sandy City, Utah. The upstream service publishes no description for this layer. 102 multipolygon features, mirrored as GeoParquet in EPSG:3566 (NAD83(HARN) / Utah Central (ftUS)) with Web Mercator vector tiles for display. See the [agent guide](AGENTS.md) for the schema, the coded-value lists and queries that run.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
table:columns.description: Per-row bounding box written by gpio, as a struct of `xmin`, `ymin`, `xmax`, `ymax`, in the same coordinate system as the geometry. Rows are in Hilbert order, so filtering on this column prunes row groups efficiently.
